# meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_events_rollbacks (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Network Firmware Upgrades Staged Events Rollbacks` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_events_rollbacks" "example" {
  network_id = "L_123456"
  reasons = [
    {
      category = "performance"
      comment  = "Network was slower with the upgrade"
    }
  ]
  stages = [
    {
      group_id                 = "1234"
      milestones_scheduled_for = "2018-02-11T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID
- `stages` (Attributes List) All completed or in-progress stages in the network with their new start times. All pending stages will be canceled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stages))

### Optional

- `reasons` (Attributes List) The reason for rolling back the staged upgrade (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reasons))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--stages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stages`

Optional:

- `group_id` (String) ID of the Staged Upgrade Group
- `milestones_scheduled_for` (String) The start time of the staged upgrade stage. (In ISO-8601 format, in the time zone of the network.)


<a id="nestedatt--reasons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reasons`

Required:

- `category` (String) Reason for the rollback
  - Choices: `broke old features`, `other`, `performance`, `stability`, `testing`, `unifying networks versions`
- `comment` (String) Additional comment about the rollback
